distribution_authorization.scope_limit: Exact four eligible retained payloads, custody metadata, evidence-gap crosswalk, schemas, and pointer-only frontier discovery metadata; no private data or unauthorized source payloads.

custody_states.meaning: Exact local payload bytes are present and bound by path, media type, byte size, and SHA-256.
Only source identity and discovery metadata are admitted by this profile; any historically observed payload is excluded from current evidentiary and distribution use.
A payload is expected but no exact admissible local bytes are currently bound.

redistribution_states.meaning: Observed source terms permit payload redistribution when the recorded attribution obligations are met.
Observed source terms permit payload redistribution subject to all recorded obligations and caveats.
Local retention is allowed, but payload redistribution is not established by the recorded basis.
Only the pointer and custody metadata may be distributed; no source payload is included.
The recorded basis prohibits payload redistribution.
No redistribution determination has been made.

evidence_eligibility_states.meaning: Exact retained bytes may support only a proposed, scope-bounded mapping; they do not establish scientific support, legal interpretation, safety, conformance, certification, compliance, or acceptance.
The record is discovery or custody metadata only and cannot support a standards, scientific, safety, benchmark, or compliance proposition.
No admissible retained payload is available, so the record cannot support an evidentiary proposition.

invariants: Custody does not imply redistribution permission.
Redistribution permission does not imply evidentiary eligibility.
A pointer, URL, prior digest, checksum, or generated record is not retained source evidence.
Only exact retained payloads marked eligible_for_proposed_mapping may appear in evidence_source_refs.
Pointer-only and pending records must remain evidence-ineligible and may appear only in discovery_source_refs or custody permission bases.
Prior observed payload metadata preserves audit history but does not re-admit excluded bytes.
Operator authorization is limited to static public repository distribution of the exact four inventory-bound payloads and pointer metadata.
Distribution authorization is not Gate A acceptance, GA-17 evaluation, scientific support, safety authority, compliance, or scientific-publication acceptance.
The profile and inventory remain immutable with distribution_executed false; a separate append-only receipt binds their exact digests after a successful push and records distribution_executed true.
No custody state supports a scientific, safety, legal, standards, benchmark, certification, compliance, or operator-acceptance conclusion.
